Previously saved options absent from the latest scan are retained, not assumed discontinued. confirmed is a user checkbox, not automated verification. Exports include your supplier details and notes; review before sharing. This version cannot import notes yet.

support_intro.message: This is an independent study copy. See the GitHub project for installation and maintenance, or export a diagnostic report here.

support_noGmail.message: Don't use Gmail? Copy the support address, email us from your own account and attach the report:

support_privacy.message: The report has only version, platform, counts and error categories: no product titles, URLs, cookies, license keys or API keys. The two questions below are optional and only go into the report.

support_reportSaved.message: The report file is downloading (see Chrome's downloads). Attach it to your email to support.

ux_formatHint.message: These options apply only to JPG/PNG copies. Original files are kept.

ux_helpDownload.message: Choose originals or add JPG/PNG copies next to Download. Changing format keeps your selection. Download the ZIP, then open it from Chrome downloads.

ux_helpMissing.message: Expand the description, change variants or play the video, then capture loaded media. Complete any sign-in or verification shown on the product page. If images remain missing, share the URL and error with support.

ux_helpScan.message: Open the product detail page, wait for its images, then scan. The page scrolls automatically and returns to its original position when done.

ux_helpSelect.message: Click an image to toggle selection, or select one category at a time. Switch to large images to see more detail.

ux_layoutMissing.message: Images are present, but the product media section was not recognized.

ux_layoutRecovery.message: Check that this is a single product detail page. If its images are visible, send the product URL and this message to support so this layout can be checked.

ux_loadRecovery.message: Check the product page first. Complete any sign-in or verification shown there, wait for images and expand the description, then scan again.

ux_noSelection.message: Select at least one image, or use Select all above.

ux_notProductPage.message: This page can't be scanned. Open a single Taobao or Tmall product page, then scan (home and search pages don't work).

ux_noteStart.message: Scan a product to create a note, or open an existing note below.

ux_previewError.message: This image could not be displayed. Check it on the product page.

ux_previewHint.message: Previewing does not change your selection.

ux_quickHelp.message: First time? See the three steps

ux_rescanAskFailed.message: Rescanning clears your picks and the list of {0} [[0|item|items]] that did not download, so you can no longer retry just those. Rescan?

ux_rescanAskPicks.message: Rescanning clears the picks you just changed. Rescan?

ux_retiredJob.message: This platform is no longer supported. You can remove this item.

ux_trialHint.message: Start your trial when you are ready. Download without a daily limit for seven days.

ux_welcome.message: Your product media, in one place.

ux_welcomeHint.message: Open a product detail page and scan. Main images, variants, descriptions and videos are grouped for you.

v5_batchEmptyText.message: Add products to see their download progress here.

v5_batchIntro.message: Download several products, with a ZIP for each.

v5_batchSnapshot.message: Each product keeps the settings used when added. Changes apply only to products you add next.

v5_batchTabs.message: Open product tabs in this Chrome window, then add them below.

v5_copySub.message: Convert, add borders or split tall images

v5_filterEmpty.message: No matches. Try a wider size range or clear the filters.

v5_filterSub.message: Find images by size or format

v5_guideSub.message: Get started or find missing media

v5_notesEmptyText.message: Save products, sellers and variants to find them when you restock.

v5_notesIntro.message: Keep seller details, notes and your variant codes together.

v5_notesLocal.message: Notes stay in this Chrome only. Export a backup before changing computers or removing the extension.

v5_notesPlaceholder.message: e.g. Check package size; restock in white

v5_settingsIntro.message: Your preferences are saved for next time.

v5_shortBatchHint.message: Add products from your open tabs

v5_shortNoteHint.message: Keep seller details and your item codes

v5_variantsSub.message: Add your own codes when needed

v6_panelWidthDismiss.message: Do not show this width tip again

v6_panelWidthHelpBody.message: Move your pointer to the divider between the panel and the product page. When the left-right arrow appears, click and drag. Make both image columns easy to see while leaving room to use the product page. On smaller screens, switch to Large to inspect one image at a time.

v6_panelWidthHelpTitle.message: Images too small? Adjust the panel width

warn_detail_guessed.message: Description images are a best guess

warn_main_guessed.message: Main images are a best guess
